output.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: The query adds up the 2025 net revenue and divides it by the number of customers who bought something in 2025. Following the warehouse rules, only completed orders count (is_revenue = true), so a customer "bought something" if they had at least one completed order dated 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. Shipping fees are left out, and the average is rounded to 2 decimals. The result also shows how many customers the average is based on.
